# Pinned optional Flint discovery

`flint.json` is copied unchanged from Tinkers' Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/blob/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2/src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/recipes/misc/common/flint.json

`sha256.json` records its exact bytes. The native contributor adapts only
`recipe` to the host `recipes` event predicate, and emits the advancement under
the same per-world config gate as its already-supported optional recipe.
